description: Frost Trap 60 Mana Instant 30 sec cooldown Requires Hunter Requires level 28 Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
name: Frost Trap
